problem_statement: The DHCPv4 server must support RFC 8910 by including DHCP option 114 (Captive-Portal URI) in Offer and Acknowledgment messages when the client requests it via the Parameter Request List (option 55). When enabled via CONFIG_NET_DHCPV4_SERVER_OPTION_CAPTIVE_PORTAL, the server should send option 114 with a URI either from CONFIG_NET_DHCPV4_SERVER_OPTION_CAPTIVE_PORTAL_URI if non-empty, or auto-built as http://<server-IPv4>/generate_204. Clients that list option 114 in their parameter request list must receive it in both the Offer and the Ack.

verification.reason: The problem statement provides all necessary information: the Kconfig option names (CONFIG_NET_DHCPV4_SERVER_OPTION_CAPTIVE_PORTAL and CONFIG_NET_DHCPV4_SERVER_OPTION_CAPTIVE_PORTAL_URI), the behaviour (option 114 in Offer and Ack when the client lists it in the PRL), the URI logic (override when non-empty, otherwise http://<server-IPv4>/generate_204), and the numeric option value (114). The macro name DHCPV4_OPTIONS_CAPTIVE_PORTAL follows directly from the existing naming convention in dhcpv4_internal.h (DHCPV4_OPTIONS_<DESCRIPTION>) combined with the 'option 114 (Captive-Portal URI)' phrasing in the statement, which a competent developer can determine without seeing the tests.
